sources.prompt:
Use case: sprite-sheet. Reference/edit target is the selected standard PRIMARY CUTTER eight-view idle frame0 PNG. Create ONE complete frame3 sheet, exactly same FOUR-column TWO-row layout and same eight engine views N NE E SE / S SW W NW.
Preserve the EXACT model, cab, cylinder, steel cutter phase0, wheels, couplers, colors, scale, top-left light and ground contacts. Change ONLY the tiny amber bulb on the blue cab roof to bright PALE YELLOW-AMBER (luminance230). The bulb itself is bright, no halo outside sprite, no headlight elsewhere. Cutter/wheels remain stopped; no debris.
All EIGHT sprites must be present: top row N(front up/rear cab down), NE(front upper-right/rear cab lower-left), E(front right/rear cab left), SE(front lower-right/rear cab upper-left); bottom row S(front down/rear cab up), SW(front lower-left/rear cab upper-right), W(front left/rear cab right), NW(front upper-left/rear cab lower-right). The rear-facing N/NE/NW forms expose cab nearest viewer, not the cutting disk. Exact common idle chassis registration; no additional machinery or reinterpreted views.
True transparent alpha around sprites, wide alpha gutters; no text, grid, floor, rails or shadow outside body. Crisp original TTD native pixel art with 64x48 canvas and(-32,-32) world anchor. This is one bright idle equipment-cue frame for display only; do not produce extra frames or start drilling.

references.role: fixed eight-view model and cab-beacon reference

sources.selection: Selected tool-authored cab-beacon regions only, assembled at the fixed reference chassis anchor. Other generated body pixels, including the extra forward highlight in frame3 N, are excluded. This preserves the original physical body/coupler/alpha geometry; native cue review remains required.
sources.revision: New retained authored cue source; base chassis original remains immutable.
sources.crop_registration: Selected idle frame-zero per-view whole-part extents. These are explicit geometry calibration, not missing animation completion. Future state/frame registration must preserve these native contact points instead of independently recropping moving parts.
sources.component_policy: Plan13 14.3 changes only declared moving/load/status parts: deterministic packing selects these authored native component regions onto the immutable base chassis. No new colors/pixels are painted; original outputs stay byte-identical.
sources.component_sampling: Nearest source-pixel resampling for the tiny authored status component; BOX resampling remains for the fixed chassis. SW component is registered from its source lamp top to the selected reference lamp top, avoiding body-scale differences in the generated contact sheet.

sources.prompt:
Use case: sprite-sheet. Original OpenTTD permanent TBM SUPPORT EQUIPMENT CART. This is a rail flatcar, NEVER a locomotive, never a cab, never a drill. Use the guide only for engine direction geometry and canvas anchors. Draw original restrained game pixels with fixed top-left lighting.
EXACTLY EIGHT different sprites in a regular FOUR-column TWO-row transparent PNG grid, wide clear gutters. No labels, text, grid, rails or background. Fixed isometric camera and same model dimensions in all eight cells.
Cart: a low rectangular black STEEL FLATCAR on two real rail bogies, two end couplers. A small GRAY horizontal HOSE DRUM is at the cart's FRONT end. A low rectangular BLUE VENTED GENERATOR BOX is at the REAR end. Blue box has an opaque flat lid and ventilation slits, ZERO windows, ZERO windshield, ZERO glazed panels, ZERO driver's compartment. Hose drum is a steel spool with smooth rims and wrapped dark hose, no drill teeth, no cutter disk. One thin yellow safety stripe along the low flatcar edge. Entire cart low, machinery only. Front hose drum feeds the primary cutter; rear generator follows. Native canvas64x48, anchor(-32,-32), same train scale and contacts, restrained charcoal/gray/blue/yellow. No halo or outside cast shadow.
Follow these exact SCREEN positions, where FRONT always means GRAY HOSE DRUM and REAR always means BLUE VENTED BOX:
row1col1: gray drum TOP, blue box BOTTOM; vertical cart.
row1col2: gray drum UPPER-RIGHT, blue box LOWER-LEFT; diagonal up-right cart. Show the back of BLUE BOX nearest lower-left.
row1col3: gray drum RIGHT, blue box LEFT; horizontal cart.
row1col4: gray drum LOWER-RIGHT, blue box UPPER-LEFT; diagonal down-right cart.
row2col1: gray drum BOTTOM, blue box TOP; vertical cart.
row2col2: gray drum LOWER-LEFT, blue box UPPER-RIGHT; diagonal down-left cart.
row2col3: gray drum LEFT, blue box RIGHT; horizontal cart.
row2col4: gray drum UPPER-LEFT, blue box LOWER-RIGHT; diagonal up-left cart. Show the back of BLUE BOX nearest lower-right.
The second and sixth cells are OPPOSITE views, as are fourth and eighth; do not repeat diagonal perspectives. Row-major engine views N NE E SE / S SW W NW. Fixed top-left highlights in all eight. All IDLE with closed panels and tiny unlit amber equipment status bulb, no cab, no people, no spoil cargo, no drilling head or yellow cylinder. True transparent alpha. Common articulated coupler seam and normal-zoom readable low support-cart silhouette.

candidates.prompt:
Use case: sprite-sheet. Asset type: original OpenTTD standard TBM PRIMARY CUTTER rail-unit source, animation frame 0.
Reference roles: the geometry guide supplies exact engine view ordering and cutter nose vectors; standard TBM v1/rear-v1 supply yellow cutter cylinder, blue compact rear cab, steel cutting teeth and top-left lighting ONLY. Create a new coherent v2 model on REAL RAIL BOGIES/wheels, without tank tracks. Preserve reference originals unchanged.
Transparent PNG sprite sheet, EXACTLY EIGHT columns by SIX rows = 48 separate sprites, regular equal cells with wide alpha gutters. No labels, text, grid lines, background, rails, cast shadow outside the vehicle or glowing background.
Columns N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW in that exact order. Cutter-front screen vectors are N=(0,-9), NE=(14,-7), E=(20,0), SE=(14,7), S=(0,9), SW=(-14,7), W=(-20,0), NW=(-14,-7). N/NE/NW show the BLUE CAB REAR nearest the viewer and cutter facing AWAY; S/SE/SW show the steel round cutter disk facing TOWARD viewer; E nose right, W nose left. Draw genuine opposite views, not copies of a near view. Fixed isometric TTD camera and TOP-LEFT light even when heading changes.
One compact yellow cylindrical cutter unit with round steel toothed disk at front, blue compact cab at rear, black rail-wheel bogie underframe, small ordinary end couplers. This is ONLY the primary cutter; permanent supply/support car is a separate actual train part. No extra rear support wagon attached, no second cutter, no detachable hopper. Keep the same cab, roof, cutter silhouette, lengths, contact points, wheel diameters and world anchor in EVERY state. Native canvas64x48, anchor(-32,-32), subject inside48x32 safe area, all ground contacts fixed to native row40. Vehicle centers and coupler seams align within every column. Crisp restrained game pixels readable at normal zoom.
Rows:
1 IDLE: cutter disk teeth phase 0, stopped wheels, unlit amber beacon.
2 MOVING: same idle cutter disk phase, rail wheel rods phase 0, small lit amber beacon, no debris.
3 WORKING/boring: cutter teeth at active phase 0, small gray chips touching the leading cutter only, amber beacon. Chips stay inside common canvas; no terrain is drawn.
4 BLOCKED: same physical body and wheels, tiny red lit warning beacon, cutter stopped.
5 REVERSING/backing: same physical front/heading and cutter shape, stopped cutter disk, wheel rods phase 0, small rear WHITE backing lamp. Never turn the cutter around or imply boring backwards.
6 SERVICE: stopped cutter, small blue service light and open little side maintenance hatch. No people or separate depot, no geometry changes or disconnected parts.
All 48 sprites show the same model; only listed disk/wheel/lamp/hatch/debris parts differ by state. This is authored frame 0; don't include extra frames or captions. Genuine alpha, charcoal/steel/yellow/blue restrained palette; no company-color mask or reserved animated palette effects.
